questions.prompt: Which pair gives the longer cable’s ground distance and angle of elevation, rounded as requested?
questions.explanation: The shorter cable’s ground distance is 12/tan(50°) ≈ 10.0692 ft. The longer cable’s ground distance is 13.0692 ft, rounding to 13 ft. Using unrounded distance, θ = arctan(12/13.0692) ≈ 42.5578°, rounding to 43°.
